card.name: Linking words before a repeated term
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as after, especially, of, or used in drug-label sentences, where the next words repeat or restate a term just seen (age 50, elderly, adrenal function, MAOI).

modes.label: Repeat of a subject
modes.description: A word like especially or function comes right before the same subject is repeated.
modes.example: appears to be highest among the elderly,<< especially>> elderly women, it is impossible to rely

modes.label: Timing link before a drug
modes.description: The word of follows 14 days and leads into stopping an MAOI.
modes.example: The use of nortriptyline hydrochloride oral solution within 14 days<< of>> stopping an MAOI intended to treat psychiatric

modes.label: Age or time qualifier
modes.description: The word after links a symptom to an age.
modes.example: So new types of headache particularly<< after>> age 50 should be taken seriously

card.plain: It fires on small connecting words in label sentences just before a term that is about to be repeated or specified.
